common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production concept reference sheet for a Three.js hand-drawn manga-style tiny planet that carries an existing rainy-night Japanese neighborhood diorama. White/off-white paper backdrop between panels, delicate hand-drawn dark blue-grey ink outlines, restrained watercolor wash, light paper grain, anime cel-shaded volumes, soft desaturated colors, convincing 3D miniature collectible-model quality. NOT photorealism, NOT flat map art, NOT a game UI. Quiet, unpeopled, gentle night mood: close and mid-distance views default to gentle rain, while whole-planet views from orbit are always a CLEAR moonlit night with bright, readable stylized moonlight and no cloud cover; cool blue, grey-violet and damp stone; warm amber accents only from human lights, lanterns, hot springs, the volcano crater or the lighthouse. No people, no animals (fireflies only where specified), no moving vehicles, no text except the simple English panel labels, no watermark. Scale: 1 unit = 1 m; the planet radius is about 90 m and the town is 96 m wide, so terrain heights are exaggerated (mountains 15-26 m) while human-made objects keep true human scale (doors 2-2.2 m, steps 0.15-0.18 m, railings about 1.1 m). Every panel shows the SAME design consistently. This sheet is aesthetic reference, not a measured engineering drawing.

layouts.biome: Generate ONE large landscape sheet with exactly eight clearly separated panels in a 4-column by 2-row grid. Top row in soft neutral overcast dusk light, for reading forms and colors: GLOBE (a patch of this terrain on the curved surface of the tiny planet seen from orbit about 350 m away, planet curvature visible), AERIAL 50M (oblique bird's-eye view about 50 m away showing structure and edges), GROUND 5M (eye-level view 1.6-5 m showing materials and small details), SWATCH (labelled palette chips plus three square close-up material samples in the ink-and-watercolor treatment). Bottom row at night: GLOBE NIGHT (same framing as GLOBE, on a clear moonlit night with no rain or clouds), AERIAL NIGHT and GROUND NIGHT (same framings as the top row, in the local weather described, by default gentle rain with wet surfaces, and the night lighting described), MOTION (three small sequential frames left to right with tiny arrows showing the gentle animation described).
layouts.transition: Generate ONE large landscape sheet with exactly eight clearly separated panels in a 4-column by 2-row grid. Top row in soft neutral overcast dusk light: SECTION (side cross-section profile through the transition, first zone on the left and second zone on the right, with ground layers and relative heights), PLAN (top-down strip map of about 40 m of the transition), AERIAL 50M (oblique bird's-eye view), GROUND 5M (eye-level view standing in the transition). Bottom row: GLOBE (how this boundary reads on the curved tiny planet from orbit on a clear moonlit night), AERIAL NIGHT and GROUND NIGHT (same framings on a rainy night), DETAIL (three or four close-ups of the key edge elements). The transition must be gradual and irregular, never a straight hard line.

Top row in soft neutral overcast dusk light: CROSS SECTION (the road cross-section with surface, shoulders, ditches, railings and roadside furniture, widths shown with plain dimension lines without numbers), PLAN (top-down view of a straight piece, a curve and a junction or branch), GROUND 5M (eye-level view looking along the road), AERIAL 50M (oblique bird's-eye view of the road crossing its typical terrain). Card ID: ST01. Subject: planet style bible board (星球风格总板). Zone and placement: 全局; 不对应具体位置；所有卡片的风格基准，必须第一个生成。 Scale: 城镇建筑 3–14 m；杂木 4–7 m；杉树 8–12 m；山脉 15–22 m；火山 26 m。 Form: 把现有城镇的赛璐璐、墨线、水彩、纸纹语言扩展到自然地貌：团块状树冠、轮廓清楚的山脊、带淡彩层次的水面。 Palette and materials: 夜色冷蓝、灰紫、潮湿石灰；植被低饱和蓝绿与橄榄绿；水为灰青到靛蓝；暖琥珀只来自人类灯光、灯笼、温泉、火山口和灯塔；隐藏线索为极淡冷青白。 Required details: 色板色块；三种距离下的墨线粗细对照（建筑、单棵树、山脊轮廓）；水、树叶、岩石、雪、沙、泥土六种材质的水彩与纸纹样本；各类光源的亮度对照（月光、路灯、灯笼、温泉、火山口、萤火虫、隐藏线索微光）。 Motion to convey: 不需要。 Night lighting: 下排的街角、林间、海岸三格为雨夜（近距离的默认天气）；星球全景一格为晴朗的月夜（全景距离总是晴朗）。 Ink lines: 演示墨线随距离变化的规则：近处描单物，远处只描轮廓。 Must avoid: 不要出现写实照片质感、霓虹赛博朋克色、饱和的纯绿或纯蓝。
